summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, announcing the early redemption of all its outstanding 4.70% senior notes due December 16, 2026. The redemption price is 100.465% of the principal amount, plus accrued and unpaid interest, effective May 29, 2026. C$450 million in principal is outstanding. The trustee is Computershare Advantage Trust of Canada. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation. There are no terms involving acquisitions, divestitures, or corporate control changes. The filing serves as a notice to noteholders. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
